title: WebAnything：从真实网页到可扩展的智能体环境
summary: WebAnything 是一个全自动框架，可从真实 URL 重建基于源站、可复用的 Web 环境，无需逐站人工实现。它构建了 244 个网站工件、覆盖 14 个领域，支持 12,984 个任务；在保真度盲审中 12 胜 2 平 0 负，微调 Qwen3.5-9B 后 WebArena-Verified 成功率提升 13.33 个百分点。
summary_en: WebAnything is a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable web environments from real URLs without per-site manual engineering. It built 244 site artifacts across 14 domains supporting 12,984 tasks, won 12 of 14 blind fidelity audits, and fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on its trajectories raised WebArena-Verified success by 13.33 points.
